title: Curiosity about how it works. Not opinion

content_html:
I have a real problem analyzing stocks. I am too humble. I know that I am a fucking undergrad student that does not know a shit about the market and that probably does not have a better opinion than the average analyst.

Although this can be somehow good, it makes me less incentivize to analyze stocks, dive into them, and ahve the intelectual curiosity to understand and create a point. I don't think that this is wrong. I cannot believe that the market is fucking idiot.

What should drive is instead, more related to the intelectual curiosity to understand what actually drives the stock. I don't need to have an opinion, but I should know what are the things that matter and what I would need to have a variant view on to buy/sell the stock.

Have the mental model. Operate under it and be driven by it.
